ideas.idea: Use a real <Link to="/features"> instead of the clickable div on the home page, and add it to the nav
ideas.why: This restates the known /features link problem; it is accurate but already graded, so it adds nothing new.

ideas.idea: Keep only one of robots.txt disallow or noindex for /dashboard
ideas.why: The report itself notes /dashboard is deliberate, and the Disallow plus noindex combination is a deliberate choice; the advice to drop one is of marginal value and partly undermines the private page setup.

ideas.idea: Give pricing its own title, description and canonical
ideas.why: This duplicates the known pricing meta problem, so it is already graded.

ideas.idea: Name the actual integrations on the home page instead of 'all the tools you already use'
ideas.why: The home page claim at _index.tsx:8 names no tool, and listing real ones gives readers and machines concrete content.

ideas.idea: Add concrete plan names and contents to the pricing page
ideas.why: pricing.tsx says only 'Talk to us for a quote', so there is nothing concrete to read or cite.

ideas.idea: Add <lastmod> to sitemap entries using changelog release dates
ideas.why: Valid but low effect; the sitemap has no lastmod, but only the changelog has dates and its entries are not even in server HTML.
Having no JSON-LD is declared not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add charset and viewport meta tags in root.tsx
ideas.why: Applies to nearly any site and the Remix defaults are easy to add, with little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Cross-link features, pricing and changelog pages to each other
ideas.why: These pages have no links between them, and only the root nav links to pricing and changelog, so internal links would help crawlers and readers reach features.

ideas.idea: Give each changelog entry its own page/URL
ideas.why: Entries are bare <li> items on one page, so separate addresses would make each release findable and citable.

ideas.idea: Use a consistent title pattern across pages
ideas.why: Real inconsistency exists between the home title and the '| Atlas' pattern, but the effect is small.

ideas.idea: Replace the root default title 'Atlas' with a descriptive one
ideas.why: root.tsx:2 gives only 'Atlas', which is what pricing inherits, so a descriptive default would help the page that lacks its own meta.
